E1803

Application authority is undecided or denies a required effect; the Why line says in one sentence what the program tried to do and which policy has not allowed it.

What

Application authority is undecided or denies a required effect; the Why line says in one sentence what the program tried to do and which policy has not allowed it.

Why

Execution stops before host state changes. A package.jet with no authority block, like a file with no package block, already allows printing, reading input, allocating memory, and reading the program's own arguments; any other effect needs a written grant. `--json` carries the raw `required_effects`, `granted_effects`, `denied_effects`, and `authority` facts.

Fix

Add the effects the report names under `authority.holds` in `package.jet`, for example `allow: [FS, IO]`; writing an authority block replaces the default, so list every effect the program needs. A program with no `package.jet` declares that complete row in a leading `package { … }` block of its entry file; `jet fix --all` inserts that block. Otherwise deny effects deliberately, or approve the exact operation once or for the project in an interactive terminal.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1803: tests/ui/e1803_script_inline_authority.stderr.

Error [E1803]: Application authority is undecided for `FS`
 Why: required_effects=FS, IO, Panic; granted_effects=Exec, IO, Mem.Alloc; denied_effects=; denied_required_effects=none; undecided_effects=FS; authority=application default
 Fix: Declare the complete row `allow: [FS, IO]` under `authority.holds` in a leading `package { … }` block of this file (`jet fix --all` inserts it); otherwise approve the exact operation once in an interactive terminal
 Denial: authority
 Scope chain: application default
